method.control_gate: The candidate must add no reports on unchanged, wrong-reference, replacement, removal, static, or near-static controls. Count any preexisting single reports on those controls separately.
method.distribution: Original 4 cached preflight recordings for development, 8 previously checked but development-disjoint cached confirmation recordings for held edit recipes. All media comes from the same CC BY 4.0 deposit.
method.matcher: Ordered alignment with exactly two or three query insertions and every earlier picture retained. Minimize summed standardized luma absolute differences. Check temporal content in each retained span, reject substantially better local alignments, and preserve plausible endpoint bounds across near-ties. Prefer the existing result on ties.
method.process: No learned weights. Exact 24 fps retained-frame clocks verified independently by FFmpeg framehash. Each delivery preserves the authored source sequence and native frame counts. The comparison carries zero AI weight.
